name: codex-review
description: OpenAI Codex's native review workflow (codex review / codex exec review) replicated as a Claude Code plugin: an isolated reviewer subagent carrying the Codex review rubric, four review targets with merge-base parity, and a findings + verdict handoff. v0.2.0 adds multi-agent effort levels (plain|medium|high|xhigh|max): lens-partitioned finders, rubric-standard verifiers, a sweep pass, and adversarial voting.
